deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications run October 1, 2026 to June 1, 2027, but international applicants are told to apply at least 6 months before the deadline (by about December 1, 2026) to allow for study permits.
deadline.quote: Accepting applications for Fall 2027 start: October 1, 2026 - June 1, 2027.

also.quote: International applicants should apply at least 6 months before the noted deadlines

gre_subject.value: The chemistry pages checked do not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: You must secure a position with a faculty member before applying.
supervisor.quote: A position with a faculty member must be secured before applying to the chemistry graduate program.

funding.value: All incoming graduate students are funded; PhD students currently receive CAD 36,400 a year including the CAD 5,400 PhD Research Scholarship.
funding.quote: The Department of Chemistry offers funding to all incoming graduate students. | PhD Students: $36,400*

entry_route.value: PhD applicants should normally hold an MSc (CGPA 3.0/4.33); exceptional first-class BSc holders (CGPA 3.5/4.33) may be admitted directly.
entry_route.quote: Students looking to enter the PhD program should have MSc degree from Simon Fraser University or its equivalent from a recognized institution with at minimum cumulative grade point average of 3.0/4.33. In special circumstances, exceptionally able students with first-class BSc degrees may be admitted directly to the PhD program
